title: 第376章 主动出击第375章 低级淬体丹
content_zh:
张昊宇愣了愣，这才恍然想起这只古灵精怪的小家伙，方才一直忙着修炼，炼丹，倒把它抛在了脑后。
他弯下腰，语气带着几分温和：“小团团，你这阵子跑哪儿去了？”
小团团晃着毛茸茸的身子，一双透亮的圆眼睛看着他，奶声奶气地开口。
“主人，我这段时间一直盯着赵家，意外发现了一桩不对劲的事……”
小团团耷拉着毛茸茸的小尾巴，圆溜溜的大眼睛里满是认真，奶声奶气地继续汇报起来。
“主人，我一直悄悄暗中监视赵家，本来只是盯着赵家族人的一举一动，结果半夜的时候，我意外撞见了一伙神秘人！”
它蹦跳着往前凑了两步，小爪子比划着，语气带着一丝凝重：“这伙人根本不是普通人，全是实打实的修炼者！”
“他们身上都裹着一层淡淡的黑雾灵气，气息阴诡又冰冷，和咱们正道修炼的灵力完全不一样。”
而且个个实力都不弱，隐匿身法特别厉害，普通人别说发现他们，就算面对面站着，也根本察觉不到半点异常。”
张昊宇原本不在意的神色瞬间收敛，眼底漫上一抹沉凝。
他单手负背，静静听着小团团的讲述，心底瞬间警惕起来。
这个世界正常修士不多，可以说是寥寥无几。
赵家只是普通的世俗家族，底蕴浅薄，根本不可能结识修行界的人物，更别说招揽一群身怀诡异修为的神秘修炼者。
“你仔细说说，他们一共有几人，在赵家做了什么？”张昊宇沉声问道。
小团团立刻条理清晰地回道：“一共六个人，全都穿着统一的黑色劲装，脸上戴着遮面银纹面具，不露半点容貌。”
“他们深夜悄悄潜入赵家密室，和赵家的家主偷偷密谈了很久！”
“我隔着阵法屏障偷听，他们说话十分谨慎，只零碎听到他们提及交易、资源、蛰伏、伺机而动这些字眼。”
“而且他们临走前，还给了赵家主一个黑色的古朴木盒，里面锁着浓郁的阴邪气息，我隔着老远都能感觉到那股邪气特别害人！”
张昊宇眸光微沉，指尖轻轻摩挲着，心中思绪飞速流转。
赵家近期针对自己，暗藏敌意，原来背后根本不是依仗世俗权势撑腰。

而是暗中勾结了来历不明的邪修势力！
这群神秘修炼者隐匿暗处，蛰伏在赵家，显然是有所图谋，绝对是一大隐患。
若是今日没有小团团暗中探查发现此事，任由对方暗中布局、悄然蓄力，日后必定会给自己带来不小的麻烦。
想到这里，张昊宇眼神锐利了几分，轻声道：“做得很好，小团团。这次多亏了你细心探查，发现了这个隐秘。”
得到主人的夸奖，小团团瞬间晃着小尾巴，毛茸茸的身子微微挺直，一副骄傲十足的模样。
张昊宇望着乖巧邀功的小团团，心中寒意渐生。
赵家不过是本地一户世俗家族，无修为、无传承、无底蕴。
平日里顶多仗着家世横行霸道，怎么可能无缘无故引来一批阴邪修炼者暗中相助？
这其中，必然藏着巨大的猫腻。
他低头看向小团团，语气沉稳：“你还看到什么？他们有没有留下据点，或是说过什么时候再来？”
小团团认真回想，他们没有留下据点，谈完之后就全部悄无声息离开了，身法特别诡异，像是融入夜色一般。
不过我听到那个带头的黑衣人说，三日后会再来赵家，验收‘成果’，还要赵家主准备好承诺的东西。”
content_en:
Zhang Haoyu was stunned for a moment, and then he suddenly remembered this weird little guy. He had been busy practicing and refining elixirs just now, but he had forgotten about it.
He bent down and said with a gentle tone: "Xiao Tuantuan, where have you been these days?"
Little Tuantuan shook his furry body, looked at him with a pair of bright round eyes, and spoke in a milky voice.
"Master, I have been keeping an eye on the Zhao family during this period, and I accidentally discovered something wrong..."
Little Tuantuan drooped his furry little tail, his big round eyes were full of seriousness, and he continued to report in a sweet voice.
"Master, I have been quietly monitoring the Zhao family. Originally I was just watching every move of the Zhao family, but in the middle of the night, I accidentally bumped into a group of mysterious people!"
It jumped forward and took two steps forward, gesturing with its little paws, and said with a solemn tone: "This group of people are not ordinary people at all, they are all real cultivators!"
"They are all wrapped in a faint layer of black mist spiritual energy. The aura is sinister and cold. It is completely different from the spiritual power we cultivate in the righteous way."
And all of them are not weak in strength, and their concealment skills are particularly powerful. Even if ordinary people are standing face to face with them, let alone discovering them, they will not notice anything abnormal at all. "
Zhang Haoyu's originally indifferent expression instantly faded, and there was a hint of concentration in his eyes.
He put his hands on his back and listened quietly to Xiao Tuantuan's story, feeling instantly alert in his heart.
There are not many normal monks in this world, it can be said that there are only a few.
The Zhao family is just an ordinary secular family with a shallow foundation. It is impossible to get to know people in the cultivation world, let alone recruit a group of mysterious cultivators with strange cultivation abilities.
"Tell me carefully, how many people are there in total, and what did they do in Zhao's house? "Zhang Haoyu asked in a deep voice.
Xiao Tuantuan immediately replied in a clear and coherent manner: "There are six people in total, all wearing uniform black costumes, with silver-patterned masks covering their faces, not revealing any of their appearance. "
"They quietly sneaked into the Zhao family's secret room late at night and had a secret conversation with the head of the Zhao family for a long time! "
"I eavesdropped through the formation barrier. They spoke very cautiously, and I only heard fragmentary mention of the words trade, resources, dormant, and waiting for opportunities. "
"Besides, before they left, they gave Mr. Zhao a black and simple wooden box, which contained a strong evil aura. I could feel that evil aura from a long distance away, and it was particularly harmful! "
Zhang Haoyu's eyes darkened slightly, his fingertips gently caressed, and his thoughts were flowing rapidly in his heart.
The Zhao family's recent hidden hostility towards themselves turns out to be not backed by secular power at all.
Instead, they secretly colluded with evil cultivators of unknown origin!
This group of mysterious cultivators hide in the dark and lurk in the Zhao family. They obviously have an agenda and are definitely a big hidden danger.
If there is no small group secretly investigating and discovering this matter today, and allowing the other party to secretly plan and quietly accumulate strength, it will definitely bring a lot of trouble to themselves in the future.
Thinking of this, Zhang Haoyu's eyes became sharper and he said softly: "Well done, Xiao Tuantuan. This time, thanks to your careful investigation, I discovered this secret. "
After being praised by his master, Little Tuantuan swung his tail instantly, straightened his furry body slightly, and looked proud.
Zhang Haoyu felt a chill growing in his heart as he looked at the obedient little boy asking for credit.
The Zhao family is just a local secular family with no cultivation, no inheritance, and no foundation.
How could he attract a group of evil cultivators to help him secretly for no reason when he usually relied on his family background to act arrogantly?
There must be a huge trick hidden in this.
He looked down at Xiao Tuantuan and said in a calm tone: "What else do you see? Did they leave a base or say when they would come back? "
Xiao Tuantuan carefully recalled that they did not leave a stronghold. After the conversation, they all left quietly. Their movements were particularly weird, as if they melted into the night.
But I heard the man in black who took the lead said that he would come to Zhao's house again in three days., to accept the ‘results’, Patriarch Zhao needs to prepare the promised things. "
